PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy and Data Protection
PrivacyPolicy.intro_text: At MARSYS (Academic Management Platform of the Faculty of Marine Sciences, UCN), we respect and protect our users' privacy. This policy describes how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information, in strict compliance with the Chilean Personal Data Protection Law (N° 21.719).
PrivacyPolicy.collection_text: We collect information necessary for academic and administrative management, including identification data (name, RUT, institutional email), academic data (curricular progress, grades), and activity logs within the platform (laboratory requests, vehicle requests, etc.).
PrivacyPolicy.use_text: The collected data is used exclusively for the operational purposes of the MARSYS platform, such as traceability of internal processes, resource allocation, role management, and official communication within the FCM community.
PrivacyPolicy.arco_text: In accordance with Law N° 21.719, you have the right to Access, Rectify, Cancel, or Oppose the processing of your personal data. To exercise these rights, you may contact the platform administration through your institutional account.
PrivacyPolicy.cookies_text: We use strictly necessary cookies to keep your session active and interface preferences (such as language and dark/light theme). We do not use cookies for third-party advertising tracking.
PrivacyPolicy.contact_text: If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or the handling of your data, please contact the administration of the Faculty of Marine Sciences.
